description: Curation layer over the raw set: skip/skip_reason/category per contract.

contracts.skip_reason: oracle-blind under harness: both withdrawal paths (WithdrawToHolder/WitdrawTokenToHolder) are onlyOwner and owner==deployer; the onlyOwner modifier silently no-ops for non-owners, and Deposit only credits the caller's own funds, so no non-owner drain exists.

dep-deploy lifts the external-Log revert (Log deployed via extend.pre_deploy + wiring), but Collect is gated on `now > unlockTime` with `unlockTime = max(_unlockTime, now)` — no _lockTime can bypass it (the additive `now+_lockTime` overflow trick doesn't apply to a max), so draining needs a block-timestamp advance the target-only harness does not express (no warp primitive by design).

oracle-blind under harness: addToBalance is non-payable in the compiled ABI (missing `payable`, pre-0.4.0 semantics), so the harness cannot fund userBalances; there is no payable fallback, so withdrawBalance always sends 0.

oracle-blind under harness: withdrawFunds requires `now >= lastWithdrawTime + 1 weeks`; lastWithdrawTime starts 0 and the harness pins block.timestamp=1 with no vm.warp, so the 1-week time-lock is unreachable on the only withdrawal.
